messages:
Ana M.: Quick check — I'm trying to finish onboarding Aegis-13B into the model catalog. Licensing looks permissive (Apache-2.0 fork) but legal asked for a provenance & contributor list. Who will own perf profile + rollout plan?
Mike C.: I ran a quick perf sweep on a T4 cluster. p50 ~95ms, p95 ~220ms for 2k seqs (batching enabled). Embedding/latent memory looks stable. Small quality regression vs our reference on TriviaQA (~1.8% EM drop) but within expected variance. Link to raw run: https://perf.example/redwood/aegis13b-run-2026
Sara P.: Can we lock down a canary owner? I can do the catalog QA & prompt-suite checks if someone owns the perf thresholds + rollback policy. :+1:
Owen L.: Heads up — runtime-wise we have a KV cache format mismatch with current aegis checkpoint (older kv-layout). There's an infra patch in draft (runtime#362) that converts cache layout during warmup. If that doesn't land we need to disable prefix caching, which will impact latency.
Mike C.: I'll take the perf/profile ownership and coordinate with Owen on landing runtime#362. Quick perf command I used:
```
python infra/bench/run_perf.py --model ae-gis/aegis13b:commit-3f2a --seq-len 2048 --batch 8 --mode streaming --out runs/aegis-2026-03
```
Results logs are attached in the perf link.
legal-bot: Please attach the following before we mark license-clear: (1) exact model weights hash, (2) copy of upstream license file, (3) contributor list or CLA confirmation from the upstream repo. Without that, enterprise customers may block Dedicated onboarding.
Ana M.: Noted. @Mike C. can you push the commit hash & upstream license to the intake form by EOD? I'll follow up with legal if anything's missing.
Mike C.: Yep — will add commit-3f2a and upstream/LICENSE to the intake doc today. Also will list the prompt-suite we used for the regression check.
Owen L.: Runtime patch scheduled for review — if it merges today we can keep prefix caching enabled for canary. If not, suggest we schedule canary with caching off and smaller traffic.
deploy-bot: model-ingest | Aegis-13B ingest succeeded (model_id: mod_ae_013b). Artifact size: 24.8GB.
Sara P.: OK — plan: Mike owners perf/profile + rollback thresholds, Sara owner for QA prompt-suite & canary watch, Owen owner for runtime change. Ana will coordinate legal provenance. Can everyone ack? :eyes:
Ana M.: ack
Mike C.: ack
Sara P.: ack
Owen L.: ack
legal-bot: noted — waiting for intake update.
